summary_rationale: Gilead Sciences operates one of global biopharma's highest-margin, most cash-generative specialty franchises, anchored by a $20.8B HIV portfolio (FY2025, +6% YoY; accelerating to +18% YoY in Q3 2026) that combines Biktarvy's 53% U.S. treatment share and newly extended April 2036 U.S. patent settlement runway with the breakthrough launch of twice-yearly PrEP injectable Yeztugo (~$1.0B run-rate in its first full year 2026). Livdelzi (seladelpar, +93% YoY to $203M in Q3 2026) and Trodelvy's June 2026 first-line mTNBC approvals (+42% YoY to $506M in Q3 2026) validate a genuine commercial inflection beyond HIV, supporting ~80% gross margins and $9.46B of FY2025 free cash flow ($10.02B CFO). However, KPI health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unconditional PASS because: (1) M&A capital allocation has been historically uneven, with multi-billion-dollar write-downs on Immunomedics ($21B) and Forty Seven ($4.9B) plus $12.4B of 2026 acquired IPR&D charges (led by the $7.8B Arcellx buyout) depressing GAAP ROE and ROIC into negative territory; (2) Kite cell therapy sales are declining mid-teens in 2026 ahead of the December 23, 2026 anito-cel PDUFA decision; and (3) Biktarvy faces a 38% IRA Maximum Fair Price cut ($2,600/30-day supply, ~$1.5B annual revenue headwind) beginning January 1, 2028.
